_about: Public-domain Charles Bridges (1794-1869, evangelical Anglican, vicar of Old Newton, Suffolk) for the Word Hoard: the Works (New York: Robert Carter, 1849, 3 vols) and the Exposition of Ecclesiastes (New York: Carter, 1860), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
